name: lyra-workspace
description: A small, portable agent core for Grove
author: Autumn Brown <autumn@grove.place>

scripts.typecheck: tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.json && tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.workers.json && tsc --noEmit -p scripts/tsconfig.json && tsc --noEmit -p examples/workers-minimal/tsconfig.json && tsc --noEmit -p packages/lyra/live/tsconfig.json
scripts.ci: pnpm format && pnpm typecheck && pnpm build && pnpm test && pnpm test:workers && pnpm fuzz && pnpm importcheck && pnpm matrixcheck && pnpm build:example && pnpm budget && pnpm coverage
scripts.test:workers: vitest run --config vitest.workers.config.ts && vitest run --config vitest.ws.config.ts
